description: Curated starter corpus for AgriBot AI. Every URL was checked to be reachable (HTTP 200) with substantive text on 2026-10-24. Titles are curated from each page's heading; the original HTML <title> is stored in each document's .meta.json after fetching. published_date is null because the pages do not state a publication date.
licensing_note: The TNAU Agritech Portal disclaimer (https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/disclaimer_en.html) does not grant an explicit reuse licence; pages carry '© All Rights Reserved. TNAU'. Content is used here as attributed excerpts for non-commercial educational purposes. Obtain permission before redistributing the corpus publicly.
